integrity: The proof derives local completed equations from the published sextic formula and published singular strata. The symbolic checker verifies expansions and delta bookkeeping; it is not used as a substitute for the all-parameter local proof.
scientific_limitations: Restricted to the part-II sextic over an algebraically closed field of characteristic 0 or at least 5 with eight pairwise distinct branch points. It does not classify the different part-I sextic family or projective equivalence of parameters. A residual originality risk is an unindexed equivalent ADE refinement.
title: Complete ADE refinement of the genus-five Howe sextic singularity table
